planets.name: K2-141 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-141 with a 0.28-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-141 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-141. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONOMO_ET_AL_2023): disc_year 2018, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 0.2803246, pl_radj 0.13471341, pl_bmassj 0.01563737

quotes.title: K2-141b
quotes.card: K2-141b is a massive rocky exoplanet orbiting extremely close to a K Type orange main-sequence star K2-141.
quotes.introduction: The planet was first discovered by the Kepler space telescope during its K2 “Second Light” mission and later observed by the HARPS-N spectrograph.
